title: Not Very Good
text: Not Very Good. My favorite incense is sandalwood. I love the stuff. I've bought dozens of different varieties over the decades. I have a favorite that's incredibly potent that I go back to year after year but when offered the opportunity to try something new I'll jump at it. This has a fancy wood box that does a great job of protecting the incense sticks during transport. These are the style incense I prefer, there's no bamboo shaft with incense stuck to it these are incense, some filler and a binding agent of some kind. The label on the box says they were made a little over a year ago. That being said. . . there's no scent. Just the burning binder and filler, no sandalwood at all. I burned an entire stick right in front of me and there was just a burning smell. I was horribly disappointed.
